content.text:
macOS Bash 3.2 + `set -u` treats empty `"${array[@]}"` as unbound. Fixed by using `${array[@]+"${array[@]}"}` in `ec2_app_deploy.sh` (and the same pattern in `ec2_redis.sh`).

Re-run your deploy; empty optional excludes/SSH key args will expand to nothing instead of aborting.
